questions.prompt: What is the smallest positive number that is divisible by each of 3, 7 and 14?
What are the solutions of the equation $x^2 + x - 12 = 0$?
The mean mark of five students in an exam was 60. If four of the students have their marks raised by 6 and one student has his mark lowered by 4, what now will the mean mark of the five students be?
If the letters of the word MATHS are arranged in all possible ways, what is the probability that a random arrangement will commence with the letter M or the letter A?
What is the remainder when $(x^2 - x - 1)^{40}$ is divided by $x - 2$?
What is the correct ranking of the numbers $9^{\frac32}$, $4^{\frac52}$ and $30$ in order from smallest to largest?
John looked at the picture of a man on a wall and said: “Brothers and sisters I have none but that man’s father is my father’s son”. What is the relationship between the man in the picture and John?

choices.text: The man in the picture is John’s father
The man in the picture is John’s son
The man in the picture is John
The man in the picture is John’s grandfather
There is insufficient information given to determine the relationship between the two men

questions.prompt: What is the value of $\dfrac{(3i)^{10} + 3^{10}}{3^{10}}$ where $i^2 = -1$?
If the function $f(x)$ has roots $x = 3$ and $x = 5$, what are the solutions to the equation $f(x-2) = 0$?
In how many ways can 6 identical apples be distributed among 4 children if each child must get at least one apple?

In a survey of 100 secondary school teachers, 20 said they teach mathematics. Among these 20 mathematics teachers, 12 were females. If a report of Irish secondary schools stated “A survey of 100 secondary school teachers showed that 60% of them are female teachers of mathematics”, which of the following statements is valid based on the above information?

choices.text: The report is accurate because 12 out of 20 teachers is 60%
The report is accurate because $(100 - 20 - 20)$ out of 100 teachers is 60%
The report may be accurate because many male teachers also teach mathematics
The report is inaccurate because only 12% of the 100 teachers are female teachers of mathematics
The report is inaccurate because only 30% of the 100 teachers are female teachers of mathematics

questions.prompt: Assume that the probability of a child being born a boy is $\frac12$. Suppose a man says, “I have two children; at least one of them is a boy”. What is the probability that the other one is a boy?

Asia wrote down a number of consecutive members of the set $\{0, 1, 2, \ldots, 9\}$. How many of the five fractions $\frac25, \frac12, \frac47, \frac35, \frac58$ could represent the proportion of even numbers in her list?

A triangle has one side of length 6 cm and a second side of length 3 cm. If the angle between these two sides is $60^\circ$, what is the length of the third side in cm? Note if you need it that $\cos 60^\circ = \sin 30^\circ = \frac12$.
The digits of the number 1234 can be arranged in all possible ways to produce 24 numbers $1234, 1243, 1324, 1342, \ldots, 4312, 4321$. What is the sum of these 24 four-digit numbers?

If a boat takes three days to travel downstream from A to B and four days to come back upstream, how many days would it take a wooden log to be carried from A to B by the current? Assume the speed of the current is constant.
How many zeros are there at the end of the number $30! = 30 \times 29 \times 28 \times \cdots \times 3 \times 2 \times 1$?
